title: Tamal Limeño (Peruvian Corn Tamale)
description: Prepared with corn, lard, and pork.
steps: Cook four pounds of white corn in plenty of water with handfuls of quicklime to remove its skin.
After two boils, drain the water and place the corn in a trough or open vessel.
Rub and wash the corn alternately and many times until it is clean of skins, white, and without trace of lime.
Grind it until reduced to a paste and season with necessary salt, plenty of pork lard, and four eggs, kneading the mass until it has acquired consistency and softness.
Divide the mass into pieces of the size the tamales are to have, and fill them with a picadillo of cooked pork meat seasoned with hard-boiled eggs, ground ají, bacon, almonds and ground peanuts.
Wrap them in corn husks, which are prepared by soaking them to give them flexibility and washing them well.
Once wrapped, place them with little water in a pot, arranging them in squares like building a wall.
Cover the mouth of the pot very well, first with burlap folded in four, then with the lid, so that steam helps with cooking.
Cook for two hours over slow fire, adding once or twice a little hot water if the water in the pot has diminished.
After two hours of slow cooking, the tamales are ready to serve.

title: Tecti (Fermented Beverage)

steps: Cook in one arroba of water: one pound of rice, one pound of roasted peanuts, one pound of walnuts, four ounces of sweet almonds, all well cleaned and ground, adding one handful of toasted corn and one small bunch of fennel

Pour over them one cup of good broth and one cup of raw cream.
Stir again; add two tablespoons of vinegar and one of good oil.
Submerge three or four slices of bread toasted on a grill in this sauce.

title: Torta Argentina (Argentine Cake)
description: A cake made with wheat flour, lemon, and powdered sugar.

ingredients.name: half a pound of powdered sugar

steps: Prepare tin molds the size of a large plate with a wire around the edge in the form of a rim or border.
Beat the twelve eggs, reserving three egg whites.
Beat well the twelve egg yolks and nine egg whites with the butter, and once beaten, add the flour, cupped by cupped, after passing it through a sieve; then add the sugar.
All together, beat until it has become a smooth and soft mass.
Add a few drops of lemon essence.
Lightly butter the tins or molds, and cover with a very thin layer of dough, so thin that we shall call them hosts, and place them in a strong oven, which cooks them momentarily.
Once cooked, turn the molds over onto a table so that the hosts come out intact.
There should be twelve molds, extracting the hosts, and set aside the twelfth for the base.
On the host of this mold, spread a layer of dulce de leche, and on top of this a host.
On it another layer of dulce and a host.
Thus, alternately, until the twelve leaves that complete the cake, which will end with a host.
Beat in meringue point three egg whites with half a pound of powdered sugar; coat the cake with this beaten mixture and place it in a warm oven to dry the coating.

Butter a mold or heat-resistant dish and place the batter in it.
Bake in a hot oven until cooked.

title: Torta de Natas (Cream Cake)
description: A cake made with cake, cream, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: one quarter of a liter of good milk

Add half a pound of sugar and six egg yolks half-beaten, seasoning with cinnamon powder.
Cut three dozen slices of sponge cake, soak them in that milk, and arrange a layer of them at the bottom of a dish.
On this layer of sponge cake, spread another of cream, on which pour a strong sprinkling of sugar and cinnamon.
Then another layer of sponge cake, and another of cream, alternating until the dish is filled with one of sponge cake, and place it in the oven for a quarter of an hour, with moderate heat.

title: Tortilla a la Hija del Aire (Daughter of the Air Omelet)
description: Prepared with cream or milk, garlic, and onion.
steps: Break the desired number of eggs - keeping in mind that two fill a plate. Having broken the eggs, separate in different vessels the yolks and whites, and beat them: the yolks just enough for them to break down; the whites to stiff peaks: that is, until they become light and consistent foam.
Mix them in a cup of raw cream, or good milk, salt to taste, pepper, and a clove of garlic and a slice or two of onion, ground in the mortar.
Put in a pan a piece of lard on high heat. When the lard is boiling, lightly mixing the yolks, the whites in foam and the milk, stir and fry.

Since the cooking of this omelet is very quick, due to its lightness, a moment later it is necessary to divide it in a cross with the tip of a knife, and with two forks turn each of the four parts so that they finish frying.
When serving it, give it its shape, making the action of the knife disappear with a relief of sliced potatoes.

description: Prepared with lamb kidneys, juice, and wine.

ingredients.name: hot sauce or mustard sauce or tomato sauce with green chilies

steps: Beat twelve eggs to foam, and put half in a pan with butter, to cook as an omelet on moderate heat, turning it so that it cooks evenly.

In the meantime, prepare the filling by cutting lamb kidneys into small pieces and cooking them in butter, fine herbs finely chopped, four spoonfuls of roast juice, and half a glass of Jerez wine: all with seasoning of pepper and salt.
Next, spread the filling over the omelet, and pour the rest of the beaten egg over it, adding a piece of butter, and covering the pan with its lid, on which will be placed hot ash and embers.
Once the omelet is cooked, serve it with hot sauce, either mustard or tomato with green chilies.

Make a sauce of butter with a spoonful of flour dissolved in a little roast juice; half a glass of white wine, and the juice of a lemon. Cook the necessary mushrooms, cut into small pieces, in this sauce.

ingredients.name: green chiles, four, deseded and cut into small pieces

steps: Cut the turtle meat into thin slices and place in a marinade for six hours

Prepare the marinade in a wooden, ceramic, or enameled earthenware vessel: combine one bottle of vinegar, two or three tablespoons of oil, salt, pepper, oregano, half a head of ground garlic, two heads of sliced onions, and four green chiles, deseded and cut into small pieces
Arrange the turtle meat slices in this marinade, submerge them well, and let them cure for the stated time
After curing, drain and fry in an enameled pan, due to the vinegar from the marinade

After five minutes of boiling over a lively fire, the frying is done and should be served with piquant sauce, either English mustard or yellow chile, but always in roasted tomato juice passed through a sieve and with sour orange juice

title: Dulce de Cascos de Sandías (Candied Watermelon Rind)
description: Prepared with watermelon, almond, and sugar.

ingredients.name: 1.5 pounds sugar per 1 pound watermelon rind

steps: Peel the watermelon rinds and place them in the sun for half a day.

Soak them for one day in warm almond water.
Place them to cook in boiling water, remove them and drain in cold water until they lose the salt.
Strain them in a basket and weigh 1.5 pounds of sugar for every 1 pound of watermelon.
When the syrup is at medium point and cooled, add the rinds and bring to point over low fire.

title: Duraznos en Aguardiente (Peaches in Spirits)
description: Prepared with peaches, sugar, and water.
steps: Choose thirty healthy and beautiful Zaragoza peaches that are not very ripe; clean them well with a cloth and prick them to the pit with a needle.
Make a syrup with 3 pounds of sugar and before it reaches point add the peaches, stir them and let them cook until they yield to the finger.
Remove from the fire and peel them.
Let the syrup boil until it reaches thick point and cool it.
When the peaches are cold, place them in jars.
For every cup of spirits calculate two of thick syrup, fill the jars well so that the peaches remain well covered with syrup and spirits.
Cap the jars and place soaked bladder on top, tie well with twine so that no air penetrates.
If desired, calculate the spirits this way: for three of thick syrup one of spirits about thirty degrees. This method is perhaps safer.
